name: vin
description: A vifm-inspired terminal file manager with support for network protocols and user extensions.
author: Bohdan Shevchenko

scripts.build: esbuild ui/tui/index.jsx --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --jsx=automatic "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/tui.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
